relevance_note: This 16-patient thalidomide cohort of monogenic autoinflammatory diseases includes two HA20 patients with individual TNFAIP3 variants in the supplementary table ("TNFAIP3: p. R271X", "TNFAIP3: p. D70N").
method_note: Read the whole paper including the converted supplementary files; values were typed by hand from that reading and assembled with a short Python script in the scratch directory, which also cut table-row spans from the exact Markdown lines; all spans were then checked verbatim by script. Scope: of 16 patients (cohort_size_as_stated), only the 2 HA20 patients (Table 2 and supplementary table row numbers 12 and 13) carry TNFAIP3 variants; the 14 patients with variants in other genes (IFIH1, TREX1, NOD2, NLRP3, CECR1, MEFV, PLCG2, TMEM173, TNFRSF1A) get no rows. Labels: Table 2 and the supplementary table index patients with bare numbers, but the text uses its own label 'Case N' (e.g. 'Case 1', 'Case 4') and refers to these two as 'cases 4,12,13' and 'cases 5 and 12', so rule 1 gives 'Case 12' and 'Case 13'. Two previously published HA20 patients from reference [17] are mentioned in one Discussion sentence with a feature ('both showed amelioration of gastrointestinal symptoms') and treatment; they were included under the v4 passing-mention rule as 'ref [17] patient' and 'ref [17] patient 2', with no other individual detail; their phenotype row is marked 'inferred from group statement' because it comes from a sentence about both. 'Age at baseline in years' (start of thalidomide) has no schema field; it is given inside treatment_summary, not as age at last evaluation (patients were followed 12 months after baseline). Table 1 HA20 column (2 patients): counts of 1 for elevated CRP, elevated ESR, immunosuppressive agents and 'Others' (hydroxychloroquine) cannot be assigned to either patient and were not used; zeros in that column (e.g. joint, eye, haematologic, neurologic, growth, glucocorticoids) exclude no one under the v4 zero-count rule. Table 1 fever count 2 of 2 HA20 supports fever in both. Checklist 'recurrent fever' was marked observed from the per-patient 'Fever' entry together with the text 'particularly recurrent fevers (8, 50.0%)', which matches the Table 1 fever total of 8 that includes both HA20 patients. 'punctate erosion of the rectum' was mapped to 'gastrointestinal ulcers or inflammation'. Hypothyroidism was not mapped to autoimmune thyroiditis, and lung nodules were not mapped to interstitial lung disease. Exclusions (peripheral neuropathy, somnolence, numbness, tingling, pain, tremor) come from statements naming all study patients ('None of the patients...', 'none of the patients had...'); 'pain' is in the context of neuropathy screening. Anorexia and nausea for Case 12 are thalidomide adverse events and are labelled so in severity_or_detail. Inclusion/exclusion criteria (e.g. liver dysfunction, neuropathy) were not used as evidence. HA20 disease-severity grades in Table 2 (Mild/Moderate, defined in Additional file 1) were recorded in treatment_summary as treatment response, not as features. Country/ethnicity left 'not reported': the study is single-centre at Peking Union Medical College Hospital, but patient origin is not stated per patient. Variant class, zygosity, inheritance and author classification are not stated for either variant. The Discussion sentence contains a typo ('When two For HA20 patients'), quoted as printed. No contradictions about the in-scope patients were found.
